About

I'm Bashana Mihindupriya — a creative director and designer based in Sri Lanka, running Idemal Design. I specialize in crafting visual identities for events, brands, and digital experiences that feel intentional and memorable.

My work spans the full creative pipeline — from initial concept and art direction through to final execution. I bring the same level of attention to a social campaign graphic as I do to a full event identity or a custom-built web platform.

Currently open to event branding, campaign design, and web projects.
